requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: The requirement combines a functional action ('inform') with a quality criterion ('within 2 seconds'). Per Pohl §25.2, this concern-mixing issue requires decomposition into a functional requirement and a quality requirement.

source_fragments: If the glass break detector of a window detects the pane has been damaged, the system shall inform the security service.

fields.condition: the glass break detector detects the pane has been damaged

structured_requirements.final_statement: If the glass break detector of a window detects the pane has been damaged, the system shall inform the security service.
structuring_notes: Extracted the core functional action. Removed the response time constraint to isolate the quality requirement.

fields.condition: after the glass break detector detects the pane has been damaged

structured_requirements.final_statement: The system shall inform the security service within 2 seconds at the latest after the glass break detector detects the pane has been damaged.
structuring_notes: Extracted the performance constraint as a separate quality requirement.
